text: A key card. Somebody lost that. Somebody also locked a door with it. I see no connection.
A tape. Somebody recorded themselves on my equipment, in my building, without asking. Play it if you must.
A sticker. Please do not put it on the portal device. It voids the warranty. I wrote the warranty.
That belongs to a member of staff. They will be wanting it back, when they get back.
You have turned something on. I do not know what. That is not a sentence I enjoy saying.
That door is not on any plan I have. Neither, as it happens, are you.
